Theme and Styling constraints:
- Strictly LIGHT THEME only. Crisp white (#ffffff), surface background #F5F7F8, ink dark text #0B1218, secondary/muted text #5C6B76, borders #E3E9ED.
- Brand Accent: Teal #0F766E only. Soft mint wash (#e6f4f2, #ccede8). Absolutely NO purple.
- Font family: Plus Jakarta Sans.
- Professional B2B enterprise SaaS aesthetic, clean borders, crisp typography, no emojis. Layout at 1440px desktop width.

Navigation Chrome (Matches GeoLens established Semrush-style dual rail in Settings Suite):
1. Top Global Header:
   - Workspace dropdown: "nike.com (Global)" with entity indicator
   - Breadcrumbs: Settings > Billing & Plan
   - Telemetry status: "Telemetry Active (4 Engines)" in soft mint pill with green pulse
   - Global search bar: "Search settings, docs, keys... [Cmd+K]"
   - Right controls: Notification bell, help/support circle, user avatar "GL" (Spatial Ops Admin).
2. Far-left primary icon rail (72px width):
   - Logo top: GeoLens mark (teal #0F766E)
   - Navigation icons: Analysis (grid), Brand (shield/sparkle), Monitor (radar), Results (chat bubbles), Settings (gear) - SETTINGS is active with soft mint tile background and dark teal icon.
   - Bottom items: Book/Docs, Headset/Support, Collapse chevron (<<).
3. Secondary navigation rail (240px width, titled "SETTINGS" with workspace badge):
   - ENTITY & SETUP section:
     - Profile
     - Brands (badge "5")
     - Topics & tags (badge "18")
     - Channels & LLMs (badge "4 LLMs")
   - SECURITY & BILLING section:
     - Billing (ACTIVE ITEM: highlighted in teal #0F766E with "Pro" green badge)
     - API keys (indicator dot)
     - SSO & SAML ("SAML 2.0" pill)
   - Bottom rail quota footer: Synthetic Crawl Quota "28.4% used (1,420 / 5,000 queries) [Upgrade]"

Main Workspace Content — Settings / Billing:
1. Page Header:
   - Title: "Billing" with adjacent pill badge "Workspace plan · Pro Tier"
   - Subtitle: "Plan, usage, and invoices for this GeoLens workspace"
   - Top right actions: Secondary button "Change Payment Method", Primary Teal button "Upgrade Plan" (with teal #0F766E fill, white text).
2. KPI Metric Cards (4 cards across):
   - Current Plan: "Pro Annual" with subtext "$249 / month billed annually"
   - Active Seats: "8 of 10 Seats" with subtext "2 team invites pending"
   - Prompt Quota Used: "28.4%" with progress indicator "1,420 / 5,000 queries used"
   - Next Renewal: "Nov 14, 2025" with badge "Auto-renew active"
3. Two-Column Layout (Main column ~70%, Side column ~30%):
   A. Main Column:
      - Card 1: Current Plan Details & Entitlements
        - Header: "Pro Workspace Tier" with active badge and monthly cost
        - Included entitlements checklist: 5,000 synthetic crawl queries/mo, 4 active foundation LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Perplexity, Gemini, Google SGE), 18 target countries, 10 team seats, 1-year historical telemetry data, webhooks & CI/CD sync.
        - Actions: "Manage Subscription", "Add Extra Seats (+ $25/mo)", "Switch to Enterprise Custom".
      - Card 2: Quota & Real-time Usage Telemetry
        - Real-time monthly usage progress meters with visual bars:
          1. Synthetic Crawl Prompts: 1,420 of 5,000 used (28.4%) — Reset in 21 days
          2. Collection & Sweeps Runs: 742 of 2,000 runs (37.1%) — Automated headless cron
          3. Machine API & Webhook Requests: 14,200 of 50,000 reqs (28.4%) — REST & GraphQL
          4. Tracked Competitor Brands: 5 of 10 entities (50%)
      - Card 3: Invoices & Payment History Table
        - Table filters and export CSV button
        - Columns: INVOICE ID | DATE | BILLING PERIOD | AMOUNT | STATUS | PAYMENT METHOD | ACTION
        - Rows:
          - INV-2025-1002 | Oct 14, 2025 | Oct 14 - Nov 14, 2025 | $2,988.00 | Paid (soft green badge) | Mastercard ···· 4242 | [Download PDF] [Receipt]
          - INV-2024-1001 | Oct 14, 2024 | Oct 14 - Oct 14, 2025 | $2,988.00 | Paid (soft green badge) | Mastercard ···· 4242 | [Download PDF] [Receipt]
          - INV-2024-0512 | May 02, 2024 | Additional 5 Seats Addon | $300.00 | Paid | Mastercard ···· 4242 | [Download PDF] [Receipt]
   B. Side Column:
      - Card 1: "What counts toward quota" (Short honest informational note):
        - Clean explanatory breakdown:
          - Each synthetic query prompt executed across 1 foundation engine in 1 country = 1 query unit.
          - Follow-up fanout inquiries generated autonomously are counted at standard 1x.
          - Cached re-evaluations and static dashboard views do NOT consume quota.
          - Failed proxy connections or timeout crawl attempts are automatically refunded to your pool.
      - Card 2: Payment Method on File:
        - Mastercard ending in 4242 (Expires 08/28)
        - Billing contact: billing@nike.com
        - VAT/Tax ID: US-94-3128910 (Verified)
        - Action: "Edit Details"
      - Card 3: Need Custom Enterprise Quotas?
        - High-volume residential proxy nodes, dedicated LLM test harnesses, custom SLAs, or invoice billing (ACH/Wire).
        - "Talk to Solutions Engineering" teal text link.

This design system establishes a high-density, analytical workspace engineered for spatial intelligence, enterprise location analysis, and competitive benchmarking. It targets enterprise strategists, data scientists, and operations executives who rely on swift pattern recognition across multi-layered geospatial datasets.

The aesthetic philosophy balances modern architectural restraint with high-functioning utilitarianism. By pairing crisp, structural neutrals with concentrated teal focal points, the interface creates an environment of calm focus and absolute precision. Every element communicates reliability, analytical rigor, and quiet confidence—deliberately avoiding decorative noise, gratuitous gradients, or dark-mode cognitive strain.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model utilizes a fluid 12-column analytical grid flanked by persistent floating control panels and interactive side inspectors. Spacing adheres to a strict 4px/8px modular cadence.

### Breakpoints & Adaptability
- **Desktop Wide (≥1440px)**: 12-column grid, fluid analytical viewport, 24px gutters, fixed-width tool rails (320px sidebar, 400px inspection pane).
- **Desktop/Laptop (1024px – 1439px)**: 12-column grid, 16px gutters, collapsible secondary drawer, map/chart area claims dominant flex-basis.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px)**: 8-column layout, inspector panel converts into an absolute-positioned bottom sheet.
- **Mobile (<768px)**: Single-column flow with full-width horizontal-scroll cards, stacked key performance tiles, 16px outer safety margins.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses crisp, ambient low-blur drop shadows paired with fine boundary lines to maintain clarity across dense spatial layers. 

### Elevation Tiers
- **Tier 0 (Base Surface)**: `#F5F7F8` flat canvas, no shadow.
- **Tier 1 (Cards, Data Panels, Metrics)**: Pure `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.04), 0 1px 2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.02)`.
- **Tier 2 (Hovered Cards, Dropdowns, Segment Popovers)**: `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.06), 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.03)`.
- **Tier 3 (Floating Map Controllers, Modals, Flyouts)**: `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -4px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.08), 0 4px 10px -2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.04)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action**: Solid `#0F766E` background, `#FFFFFF` bold text, 8px border radius, 0 1px 2px shadow. Hover: `#115E59`. Active: `#134E4A`.
- **Secondary Action**: `#FFFFFF` background, `#0B1218` text, 1px `#E3E9ED` border. Hover: `#F0FDF4` tint, border shifts to `#0F766E`.
- **Tertiary / Utility**: Ghost button with `#5C6B76` text. Hover: `#F5F7F8` fill, `#0B1218` text.

### Cards & Analytics Panels
- Standardized with pure `#FFFFFF` background, 12px or 16px corner radius, and 1px `#E3E9ED` perimeter stroke. 
- Headers feature uppercase `#5C6B76` micro-labels (`label-md`) coupled with large `#0B1218` numeric readouts.

## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-density, analytical workspace engineered for spatial intelligence, enterprise location analysis, and competitive benchmarking. It targets enterprise strategists, data scientists, and operations executives who rely on swift pattern recognition across multi-layered geospatial datasets.

The aesthetic philosophy balances modern architectural restraint with high-functioning utilitarianism. By pairing crisp, structural neutrals with concentrated teal focal points, the interface creates an environment of calm focus and absolute precision. Every element communicates reliability, analytical rigor, and quiet confidence—deliberately avoiding decorative noise, gratuitous gradients, or dark-mode cognitive strain.

## Colors

The palette operates under a strict single-mode light paradigm, utilizing cool atmospheric tones to maintain visual comfort across prolonged analytical sessions. Purple and indigo spectrums are strictly excluded across all interface layers and chart series.

### Semantic & Surface Structure
- **Canvas Root**: `#F5F7F8` serves as the structural floor, giving subtle framing to elevated data panes.
- **Surface Panels**: Pure `#FFFFFF` for primary cards, sidebars, floating inspectors, and modals.
- **Surface Wash & States**: `#F0FDF4` and `#ECFDF5` provide ambient status washes, hover fills, and selection containers.
- **Dividers & Structural Borders**: `#E3E9ED` delivers a crisp, low-weight separation layer.
- **Typography & Icons**:
  - Primary Ink: `#0B1218` (high-contrast, anti-aliased legibility).
  - Muted Metadata: `#5C6B76` (secondary labels, axes, table metadata).
  - Disabled/Ghost: `#94A3B8`.

### Categorical & Data Visualization Engine
- **Primary Metric / Core Entity**: Deep Teal (`#0F766E`)
- **Benchmark / Competitor 1**: Sky Blue (`#0284C7`)
- **Delta Alert / Competitor 2**: Vivid Coral (`#F97316`)
- **Baseline / Competitor 3**: Slate Grey (`#94A3B8`)
- **Secondary Status Anchors**: Error `#E11D48`, Success `#10B981`.

## Typography

Plus Jakarta Sans powers the entire typographic scale. Numeric figures and data density are prioritized through medium and semibold weights, ensuring clear scanning in tables, geo-inspectors, and summary metrics.

Display and headline styles leverage tighter tracking (`-0.02em` to `-0.03em`) to anchor dashboards with executive authority. Body and label weights sit firmly at `500` and `600`, preventing light strokes from dissolving against tinted washes or light neutral backgrounds. Tabular numbers (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) must be activated globally for chart axes, spatial coordinates, and tabular metrics.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model utilizes a fluid 12-column analytical grid flanked by persistent floating control panels and interactive side inspectors. Spacing adheres to a strict 4px/8px modular cadence.

### Breakpoints & Adaptability
- **Desktop Wide (≥1440px)**: 12-column grid, fluid analytical viewport, 24px gutters, fixed-width tool rails (320px sidebar, 400px inspection pane).
- **Desktop/Laptop (1024px – 1439px)**: 12-column grid, 16px gutters, collapsible secondary drawer, map/chart area claims dominant flex-basis.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px)**: 8-column layout, inspector panel converts into an absolute-positioned bottom sheet.
- **Mobile (<768px)**: Single-column flow with full-width horizontal-scroll cards, stacked key performance tiles, 16px outer safety margins.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses crisp, ambient low-blur drop shadows paired with fine boundary lines to maintain clarity across dense spatial layers. 

### Elevation Tiers
- **Tier 0 (Base Surface)**: `#F5F7F8` flat canvas, no shadow.

## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-density, analytical workspace engineered for spatial intelligence, enterprise location analysis, and competitive benchmarking. It targets enterprise strategists, data scientists, and operations executives who rely on swift pattern recognition across multi-layered geospatial datasets.

The aesthetic philosophy balances modern architectural restraint with high-functioning utilitarianism. By pairing crisp, structural neutrals with concentrated teal focal points, the interface creates an environment of calm focus and absolute precision. Every element communicates reliability, analytical rigor, and quiet confidence—deliberately avoiding decorative noise, gratuitous gradients, or dark-mode cognitive strain.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model utilizes a fluid 12-column analytical grid flanked by persistent floating control panels and interactive side inspectors. Spacing adheres to a strict 4px/8px modular cadence.

- **Mobile (<768px)**: Single-column flow with full-width horizontal-scroll cards, stacked key performance tiles, 16px outer safety margins.

outputComponents.text:
I have designed and generated the **GeoLens — Settings / Billing** screen (GeoLens — Settings / Billing), maintaining exact continuity with the established GeoLens light-theme architecture and Semrush-style dual-rail navigation.

### Key Design & Functional Highlights:

1. **Strict Brand & Color System:**
   - **Primary Palette:** GeoLens signature deep teal (`#0F766E`) and soft mint container washes (`#e6f4f2`, `#ccede8`).
   - **Neutrals & Surfaces:** Pure crisp white (`#FFFFFF`) card surfaces, soft cool canvas (`#F5F7F8`), ink typography (`#0B1218`), muted labels (`#5C6B76`), and crisp structural borders (`#E3E9ED`). Zero purple or stray accents.
   - **Typography & Polish:** Plus Jakarta Sans with crisp tabular data formatting, status badges, and professional B2B styling.

2. **Semrush-Style Dual-Rail Navigation Chrome:**
   - **Primary 72px Icon Rail:** GeoLens brand mark, suite navigation icons (*Analysis*, *Brand*, *Monitor*, *Results*, with *Settings* active in a soft mint tile), docs, support, and collapse controls.
   - **Secondary 240px Navigation Rail:** "SETTINGS" suite title, *Entity & Setup* links (*Profile*, *Brands*, *Topics & tags*, *Channels*), and *Security & Billing* links with **Billing** prominently active in brand teal with a "Pro" badge.
   - **Top Global Header:** Multi-brand workspace dropdown (`nike.com (Global)`), active breadcrumbs (`Settings > Billing & Plan`), 4-engine live telemetry indicator, Cmd+K search, and user profile.

3. **Billing Overview & Top KPIs:**
   - **Current Plan:** `Pro Annual` ($249/month billed annually).
   - **Active Seats:** `8 of 10 Seats` with pending invitation alerts.
   - **Prompt Quota Used:** `28.4%` (1,420 / 5,000 queries used).
   - **Next Renewal:** `Nov 14, 2025` with auto-renew status.

4. **Plan Management & Detailed Usage Telemetry:**
   - **Active Tier Entitlements Card:** Direct checklist of included capacity (synthetic queries, 4 foundation LLMs, 18 target countries, team seats, API webhooks) with quick actions (`Manage Subscription`, `Add Extra Seats`, `Upgrade Plan`).
   - **Granular Usage Meters:** Visual progress bars for synthetic crawl queries, daily collection & sweep cron jobs, machine API/webhook calls, and tracked competitor slots.

5. **Invoices Ledger & Transparent Quota Policy:**
   - **Invoices & Payment History Table:** Complete record of invoices with dates, billing periods, amounts, paid status badges, and direct PDF download links.
   - **"What counts toward quota" Informational Card:** Direct, honest breakdown clarifying how multi-engine queries and autonomous fanouts are metered, while confirming that cached views and failed proxy timeouts never consume credits.
   - **Payment & Enterprise Inquiries:** Verified Mastercard on file, billing contact, and enterprise upgrade pathways.
